_doc: Per-key budgets for ux/ui-strings.json, for the Game Developer's build-time pixel-width lint (first-minute §8, engine review O-U3). LINT: substitute worstCasePlaceholders, drop LRI/PDI, measure with the real Sevev 5x9 advances (glyph width + 1, space 3) times the box's scale. PASS if it fits the box in `lines` lines at the base scale, and at base+1 (large text) either fits in `linesLarge` or may step down to the base scale. A key with joke:true must never need truncation (its punchline is last). html/share-text/og keys are checked by maxChars only (system font). surface 'unused' keys are not rendered in od-sevev. Box geometry is ux/rtl-map.md.

fontMetrics.shareCards: art scale 1 on the x5 card grid

rowA.counter.where: Row A counter (7-row numeral cut), centred x 196-524

rowA.rate.where: Row A rate line, centred x 188-532

rowB.stamp.where: Blackout stamp inner (baked art; text is the a11y fallback)

ticker.crawl.where: Crawl: no width limit; paged by width 384 under reduced motion

card.line2.where: Card line 2, x 220-568 (the owned badge overlaps the plate corner at x 572+)

card.line2wide.where: Card line 2 when no owned badge shows, x 220-580

card.pill.where: Pill line (verb or price), pill 184 wide

card.owned.where: Owned badge on the plate corner (PxText)

perk.level.where: Clause level on an agreement row (PxText)

chat.bubble.where: Bubble text column (104 art px, 17 glyphs)

chat.pill.where: Pay pill inner (kit 9-slice stretched to 82x17 art)

chat.pillWide.where: Rejoin / poach pill on a system line (visual 512)

chat.banner.where: Transfer / brawl banner line (the card grows)

sheet.title.where: Sheet / modal title (clears the top-left close)

court.btn.where: Court primary button line (2-line button: verb / price)

receipt.wrap.where: Receipt line allowed to wrap to 2

receipt.item.where: Receipt item, amount on the same line

RESULT_FOOT.note: The URL MUST be on the image (see RECEIPT_FOOT_URL)
